{{Top|leg}}
'''The Catier Walkway''' was a shopping gallery on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

After the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]], the Catier Walkway became the headquarters of a [[Walkway Collective|band of survivors]], led by [[Tenga Javik]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and a [[Wraith Squadron]] strike team met with the survivors, hoping to provide aid in setting up resistance cells.
